ribbon.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: environment art-direction paintover of a real playable game screenshot. Input image is the exact existing Slipstream gameplay view. Reimagine the surrounding space as an abandoned waterpark on a lush tropical volcanic island. Keep the exact player, skateboard, track centre line, playable widths, turns, camera perspective, crates and existing HUD positions unchanged. Improve only environmental presentation and material quality. Replace the flat barren tiled hillside and floating mountain-cloud backdrop with dense layered tropical palms, rich broadleaf canopy, dark mossy rock ravine, distant turquoise ocean and humid atmospheric haze. Ahead on the bend introduce the mouth of a fully enclosed weathered turquoise fiberglass flume tunnel with a thick rolled circular portal, shaded teal interior and warm sunlight at its far exit; it must clearly surround the existing racing lane, roof and both sides, with generous clearance. Integrate the flume structure with eroded island cliffs, rusted supports that never intersect the track, restrained vines and overgrown service decks. Premium stylized 3D game environment art, appealing sculpted forms and coherent hand-painted surfaces, organic vegetation silhouettes, no repeating visible terrain tiles, no empty giant plane, no generic rocky cave substituted for the fiberglass tunnel. Clear legible racing line and strong foreground/midground/background depth. This is a concept study, not a screenshot claim. No added text or labels.
